postal_system.assignment_rule: A pinned Posten Bring register row whose municipality code starts with county-like 21 Svalbard or 22 Jan Mayen establishes the observed four-digit postcode, postal place, municipality reference and G, P, B or S category at the register effective time. The 21/22 fields are operational source classifications, not ordinary counties, and do not merge repository SJ into NO.
postal_system.category_rule: G is used for street addresses, P for P.O. boxes, B for both street addresses and P.O. boxes, and S for special service not used as an ordinary address. Category, territory classification and validity are retained; no area is inferred from category or a missing feature.
postal_system.postcode_area_rule: Only an exact pinned Kartverket Postnummerområder Polygon/MultiPolygon feature with compatible code, validity, CC BY 4.0 lineage, CRS, topology, coverage and digest may be shown as an official postcode area. A P.O.-box, special, route, point, municipality, settlement, island, administrative boundary, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell or nearest area never substitutes for a missing official feature.
postal_system.territory_rule: Repository identity remains SJ. Posten county-like 21 Svalbard and 22 Jan Mayen values, Kartverket source coverage, geographical territory, administration and postcode-area geometry stay distinct and are never silently merged into NO or into one another.
postal_system.rights_rule: Every Posten assignment/category body and Kartverket geometry distribution pins provider, source URL, capture and release/reference time, exact terms, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, CRS, transform, coverage, exclusions and AGID changes. Public download availability is not silently widened into processing, derivation, redistribution or public-serving permission.
postal_system.address_building_rule: Postal assignment and area geometry do not authorize an address, building, unit, occupant, owner or rightsholder. Any address or building display requires a separately identified, rights-cleared authoritative source and explicit relationship.

integration.coordinate_flow: coordinate -> pinned official SJ postcode area or explicit source-defined non-area -> separately sourced address/building context -> SJ AGID cell
integration.postcode_flow: canonical four digits -> pinned Posten 21/22 assignment and category -> matching official Kartverket area or explicit source-defined non-area -> separately sourced address/building context -> SJ AGID cells
integration.building_output_gate: separate rights-cleared address/building authority and an explicit source-defined relationship

quality_gates.pass: Every postcode remains four-character text and preserves leading zeroes.
Every current SJ assignment pins the complete Posten register version/effective time, postal place, municipality reference, 21/22 classification, G/P/B/S category, terms, schema and digest.
Each SJ code is reconciled to an exact valid Postnummerområder Polygon/MultiPolygon or an explicit source-defined non-area reason; absence is not classified by inference.
Posten 21/22 source fields and repository SJ identity are retained without silently merging NO, Svalbard and Jan Mayen artifacts.
Posten and Kartverket rights are reviewed separately and authorize the actual AGID processing, derivation, redistribution and public-serving path.
No recipient, occupant, owner, rightsholder, personal contact, title/value record, credential, shipment or delivery instruction is published.
Synthetic fixtures may verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Contracts and fail-closed authority partitions are reviewable.

A current complete Posten four-digit assignment/category denominator whose county-like 21 Svalbard and 22 Jan Mayen rows are usable under explicit reviewed AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public-serving permission. Every SJ area code is reconciled to a valid fixed Kartverket Postnummerområder Polygon/MultiPolygon under CC BY 4.0, while P.O.-box, special, route, point, unmatched and other source-defined non-area records remain explicit. Source 21/22 classifications and repository SJ identity are preserved without merging NO. The approved immutable artifact pins provider, edition, reference date, rights, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, topology, coverage, conflicts and exceptions. The real SJ API/app normalizes NNNN text, returns only valid real areas, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and displays selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence; no municipality, settlement, island, administrative boundary, Point, building, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy satisfies M2.
Separately sourced authoritative address/building records pass rights, identifier, relationship, validity, privacy, CRS, coverage and correction gates.
